name: SVC_CHANNEL_VIA
description: This table stores detailed information about how a service request was received or how an SR message was received or sent, and whom it was sent to.

columns.name: VIA_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_SERVICES_REQUESTS (SR_ID) if this channel is for an SR, or SVC_SR_MESSAGES (MESSAGE_ID) if this channel is for an SR MESSAGE.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates whether the OBJECT_ID is for SR or for SR_Message.

columns.name: CONTACT_POINT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references HZ_CONTACT_POINTS (CONTACT_POINT_ID). The CONTACT_POINT_TYPE column in HZ_CONTACT_POINT will indicate phone, email, etc.  The OWNER_TABLE_NAME column will indicate the table name (such as HZ_PARTIES) that stores the owner of the contact point, and OWNER_TABLE_ID is the foreign key to OWNER_TABLE_NAME that identifies the owner of the contact point.

columns.name: PARTY_VIA_END_POINT
columns.description: Stores the end point used to send the communication to the owner of the PARTY_ID. This column can be an email address, phone number, etc.  When PARTY_ID is null and this column is not null, this end point belongs to an adhoc party.

columns.name: ROUTING_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates how the message was routed to the PARTY_VIA_END_POINT.  For example, if the message is an email, whether the recipient is a TO, CC, or BCC recipient.

columns.name: POST_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Stores the unique identifier for the social media posting that can be used to respond via the same channel instance.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this via record is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: INBOUND_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Stores the Id value of the Inbound Object, ex: email, social etc

columns.name: COLLAB_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_COLLAB_RESOURCES.RESOURCE_ID. The COLLAB_ID column in SVC_COLLAB_RESOURCES indicates the identifier of this resource in the native system. Example: slack user or channel identifier. The COLLAB_NAME in this table indicates the resource name as shown on the native collaboration channel.
